verbatim_quote.original: The Manager asked to SEE the plan before implementation.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: The Manager asked to SEE the plan before implementation.

extracted_decision.summary: Gate implementation on Manager review and approval of the Blueprint before any file edits.
extracted_decision.rationale: The Manager wants to inspect exact edit targets, gap decisions, proposed contract text, and verification plan before implementation starts.
alternatives: Allow implementation directly from the task file
Rely only on QA and Code Reviewer approvals without a Manager preview
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Adds one review cycle before implementation; Preserves Manager control over prompt behavior changes and scope
